cutflow_efficiency_purity + selection_ef.weights: GENIE: PPFX flux CV weight (`wgt`); NuWro: composition weight; GiBUU: composition × over-ceiling event weight / campaign mean over-ceiling weight; GENIE reconstructed rows x nu-e flux-constraint weight (published flux); NuWro geo sample + surrogate: gen_weight (events at gen_pot), no composition weight, no K; GiBUU geo sample + surrogate: gen_weight (events at gen_pot), no composition weight, no K

gsur.gsur_constraint_energy: true neutrino energy joined from the Truth tables by event key (fixed 2026-10-26; until then the table's true_E = muon energy)

nsur.note: the geo sample was generated with the published (nu-e constrained) flux; no reweighting

bsur.note: the geo sample was generated with the published (nu-e constrained) flux; no reweighting

nsur.efficiency_denominator: the Truth tree of the geo surrogate file (the input population), sum of gen_weight over its signal rows

bsur.efficiency_denominator: the Truth tree of the geo surrogate file (the input population), sum of gen_weight over its signal rows

genie_truth_tree.what: GENIE + surrogate: generated population = the surrogate file's Truth tree (every event the surrogate was run on); generated signal = its signal rows x official cvweight (joined by event key) x nu-e constraint at the true neutrino energy; exposure = row share f_T of the official 30-run population of the volume x POT_30; f_in = 1 in the efficiency error (binomial)

cutflow_efficiency_purity + selection_ef.model_uncertainty: half the spread (max - min)/2 over the four ensemble universes, 'all together': member k's own vertex and muon angle for the Tracker, Apothem and angle cuts, its own momentum and angle for the reconstructed pT/pL, and every row weighted by surrogate_univ_weight[k] = the product of the three flag factors univ_weight_reco x _minos x _charge = member k's over the nominal member's probability of the row's reconstruction, MINOS-match and charge-sign outcomes (nominal MINOS, dead-time and charge bits and rows); 'components' = the same half spread with one part of the universe at a time (reco, minos, charge, flags = the three factors together, vertex, muon, kinematics = vertex + muon = the version-2 universe), everything else nominal; correlated, not adding in quadrature to 'all'

residual.comparison: GENIE + surrogate + background completion (the selected full-simulation rows generated outside the surrogate volume, at the full simulation's scale) minus GENIE full simulation over all its reconstructed events, per stage: cutflow_closure.py 'all_reconstructed'
residual.units: fractions; the figure draws the RATIO surrogate / full (key ratio = 1 + relative_difference) with the relative_* errors; difference, sigma_* and epistemic are absolute
residual.epistemic: half the spread over the four ensemble universes (vertex and angle cuts re-cut per member, rows weighted by surrogate_univ_weight[k])

muon_pT_pL_1d.normalisation: data: raw counts; predictions scaled to the data exposure (POT 8.969e+19) by POT and the published flux; GENIE: `wgt` x nu-e flux constraint; NuWro: geo sample, own cross section and composition, gen_weight x POT_data / gen_pot (9.701985e+19 POT); GiBUU: geo sample, own cross section and composition, gen_weight x POT_data / gen_pot (9.701985e+19 POT)

muon_pT_pL_1d.band: statistical (+) model in quadrature for the surrogates (model = half the spread (max - min)/2 over the four ensemble universes of the selected surrogate rows per bin, 'all together': each universe with its own vertex/angle cuts, its own reconstructed momentum and its rows weighted by surrogate_univ_weight[k] = the product of the three flag factors; the background completion is common), statistical for the full simulation; ratios likewise; chi2 with_epistemic = compare() with that half spread as a fully correlated band; *_components = the same with one part of the universe at a time (version 4)
